test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a component of Central Processing Unit?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Memory**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Memory** is an essential component of the Central Processing Unit (CPU).
 
• The CPU is responsible for executing instructions and processing data in a computer.
 
• Memory, also known as RAM (Random Access Memory), temporarily stores data and instructions that the CPU needs while performing tasks.
